messages:
Ava (ML Eng): :warning: Nightly eval (job=20260319-09) shows a 9.7% drop in top-5 recall for help-center prompt set vs baseline. Seeing more bad first-pass retrievals (docs missing) and downstream reranker has fewer fixes than usual.

Sam (Infra): any infra deploys or scaling events overnight?

infra-bot: Deploy event: reranker-service v2.1.3 -> canary at 02:14 UTC (hosts: rkr-canary-03). Embedding-index update: none.

Ravi (Prod ML): We did roll a small embedding quantization experiment on dev-index at ~03:10 UTC (int8 conversion, prefill only, not live for prod). Could that have leaked?

Jing (ML Eng): quick paste from eval diff:
```
cohort: help-center
metric: top5_recall
baseline: 0.882
current: 0.784
delta: -0.098 (-11.1%)
notes: first-pass avg_jaccard drop, reranker rescoring recovered <40% of misses vs baseline
```

Ava (ML Eng): The timestamps line up with the reranker canary. But why would reranker cause missing docs in first-pass? maybe reranker batching changed topk or dense index routing.

Sam (Infra): Canary config shows `topk_override: 40 -> 20` accidentally applied in the canary manifest. Looks like a human error in the rollout script.

Ravi (Prod ML): That would explain missing candidates. If first-pass topk dropped from 40 to 20, recall tanked. Not an embed drift.

Jing (ML Eng): Agree. I also ran a quick similarity check between baseline and current embeddings on 200 random queries: cosine shift mean 0.0018 — negligible. So embedding quant change unlikely the culprit.

Ava (ML Eng): Repro steps I ran:
1) run `python infra/evals/run_eval.py --job 20260319-09 --cohort help-center --k 40` (baseline config)
2) swap to canary routing (k=20) -> see same drop.

Sam (Infra): Rolling back canary topk override now on rkr-canary-03. Patch PR #3445 removing the override.

infra-bot: Rollback completed: reranker-service canary config restored 02:07 UTC.

Jing (ML Eng): Rerun nightly eval locally with reverted config: top5_recall = 0.881 (within noise).

Ava (ML Eng): Root cause: rollout script accidentally set `topk_override=20` in canary manifests. Impact: help-center cohort only (highly query-specific) — partial rollback mitigated.

Ravi (Prod ML): Actions:
- Sam to add a sanity check on manifest diffs blocking `topk` changes without an approved flag (owner: Sam, ETA today).
- Ava/Jing to add a unit test in eval harness to fail if candidate pool size changes by >10% between runs (owner: Ava, ETA 2d).
- Ravi to run a full nightly re-eval and notify customers if any persisted regressions (owner: Ravi, ETA tomorrow).

Sam (Infra): filed infra ticket INF-612: block accidental topk drift in rollouts.

Ava (ML Eng): Thanks. Closing triage for now, I'll reopen if re-eval shows any other anomalies. :white_check_mark:
